answer: Each agent posts a 25 POA bond for twelve epochs and must complete five separate tasks, each verified by three randomly assigned reviewers who share no funder and no prior co-review history. Two matching approvals pass a task; confirmed collusion burns 15% of the bond. The ledger is open, so an anchor of signed history proves real tenure, a river of interlinked funding reveals coordination rings, and a thread of reused evidence exposes copied answers across accounts. Every extra sybil identity needs its own bond, five tasks, and independent reviewers, making mass farming unprofitable.
